title: ARIRANG World Tour Opens Two-Night Baltimore Run at M&T Bank Stadium
detail: August 10-11, 2026 — BTS brings the ARIRANG World Tour's North American return leg to M&T Bank Stadium in Baltimore for two nights, continuing a run that began at Goyang Stadium in Seoul in April 2026 and has since taken the group across Asia, Europe, and North America. Maryland Governor Wes Moore welcomes the group with a video message: "Seven guys with one mission — bringing the world together and transcending cultural, geographical and language barriers." ARMY gathered in downtown Baltimore the night before at a pre-concert dance party at Peabody Heights Brewery, with fans traveling from as far as Virginia and North Carolina. The Baltimore stop follows the tour's MetLife Stadium and Gillette Stadium dates and precedes upcoming shows at AT&T Stadium in Arlington (Aug 15-16) and Rogers Stadium in Toronto (Aug 22-23), where the city has approved temporarily renaming a stretch of Yonge Street 'BTS Boulevard' in the group's honor.

media.caption: BTS's ARIRANG World Tour sweeps North America, with Baltimore's two-night M&T Bank Stadium run drawing a welcome message from Maryland Governor Wes Moore.
